partners.diseaseBName: neurodevelopmental disorder with poor growth, spastic tetraplegia, and hearing loss
partners.mechanism_chain: CARD11 (HGNC:14950) —DISRUPTS→ NF-kappa B signaling pathway (WP:WP444); NF-kappa B signaling pathway (WP:WP444) —LEADS_TO→ Immune dysregulation (HP:0002715); PSMC1 (HGNC:9473) —DISRUPTS→ Proteasome-mediated protein degradation (GO:0043161); Proteasome-mediated protein degradation (GO:0043161) —LEADS_TO→ Neurodevelopmental delay (HP:0001263); Proteasome-mediated protein degradation (GO:0043161) —LEADS_TO→ Spastic tetraplegia (HP:0002517); Proteasome-mediated protein degradation (GO:0043161) —LEADS_TO→ Hearing impairment (HP:0000365); Proteasome-mediated protein degradation (GO:0043161) —LEADS_TO→ Poor growth (HP:0001510). Loss-of-function mutations in CARD11 disrupt the NF-kappa B signaling pathway, leading to immune dysregulation (Disease A). Concurrently, loss-of-function mutations in PSMC1 impair proteasome-mediated protein degradation, which is critical for neuronal development and function, resulting in neurodevelopmental delay, spastic tetraplegia, hearing impairment, and poor growth (Disease B). While distinct pathways are affected, the shared concept of impaired protein homeostasis due to genetic defects links these modules.

Concurrently, loss-of-function mutations in PSMC1 impair proteasome-mediated protein degradation, which is critical for neuronal development and function, resulting in neurodevelopmental delay, spastic tetraplegia, hearing impairment, and poor growth (Disease B). While distinct pathways are affected, the shared concept of impaired protein homeostasis due to genetic defects links these modules.

falsification.text: The hypothesis would be falsified if genetic studies demonstrate that pathogenic variants in CARD11 are not associated with MONDO:0014081, or if pathogenic variants in PSMC1 are not associated with neurodevelopmental disorder with poor growth, spastic tetraplegia, and hearing loss. Furthermore, if experimental evidence shows that the NF-kappa B pathway and proteasome function are entirely independent and do not indirectly influence each other's downstream effects on cellular health and development, this would also weaken the proposed link.
falsification.gnomad_variant: The presence of common variants (gnomAD allele frequency > 1%) in the coding regions of CARD11 or PSMC1 that are not associated with either disease would challenge the proposed causal roles.
